description: What this server can answer about: which contract families on which chain (today, on Ethereum mainnet: every Morpho vault, MetaMorpho v1.0 and v1.1 and Morpho Vaults V2; Compound v3's six lending markets and the governance they share; many of the Safes that hold roles on those contracts; and the contracts of six stablecoins, USDC, USDT, USDS, DAI, PYUSD and USD1), how many contracts, and the block the data is at. Call it once to learn the scope, or with `address` to check whether one address is covered before relying on an answer.
name: get_coverage
title: What Ampdat Control covers
